description: This file defines the GenericAsyncBatchObserver class, which implements the IAsyncBatchObserver interface for observing batches of items asynchronously in Orleans streaming. It provides methods to handle next items, completion, and errors via delegate functions.

classes.name: GenericAsyncBatchObserver<T>
classes.description: An internal class that observes batches asynchronously, delegating behavior to provided functions for next items, errors, and completion.

methods.name: GenericAsyncBatchObserver
methods.description: Constructor initializing the observer with delegate functions for handling batch items, errors, and completion.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Handles receipt of a batch of items asynchronously.
